## Ctx.editPhotoGroup() method

Replaces the current message with a photo media group.

**Signature:**

```typescript
editPhotoGroup(keyboard?: ITInBoKb, data?: ITData, baseId?: string, options?: ITOptReplyPhoto): Promise<(grammy_types.Message.PhotoMessage | grammy_types.Message.VideoMessage | grammy_types.Message.AudioMessage | grammy_types.Message.DocumentMessage | grammy_types.Message.LivePhotoMessage)[]>;
```

The sent media group message object.

## Remarks

Deletes the original message and sends a new media group via `replyMediaGroup`<!-- -->. Useful when the template uses pipe-delimited `src` values.

## Example


```typescript

  await this.editPhotoGroup()
}
```
